sources.name: ticket.scxml
sources.text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="ticket" initial="new">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="customer" expr="''"/>
    <data id="subject" expr="''"/>
    <data id="priority" expr="'normal'"/>
    <data id="agent" expr="null"/>
    <data id="replies" expr="0"/>
    <data id="escalations" expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="new">
    <transition event="ticket.opened" target="triage">
      <assign location="customer" expr="_event.data.customer"/>
      <assign location="subject" expr="_event.data.subject"/>
    </transition>
  </state>
  <state id="triage">
    <transition event="ticket.triaged" target="open">
      <assign location="priority" expr="_event.data.priority"/>
    </transition>
  </state>
  <state id="open" initial="unassigned">
    <invoke id="sla" src="sla.scxml">
      <param name="minutes" expr="priority === 'urgent' ? 15 : priority === 'high' ? 60 : 240"/>
    </invoke>
    <transition event="sla.breached">
      <assign location="escalations" expr="escalations + 1"/>
      <log label="escalation" expr="subject + ' for ' + customer + ' breached its ' + priority + ' SLA'"/>
    </transition>
    <transition event="ticket.resolved" target="resolved"/>
    <state id="unassigned">
      <transition event="agent.assigned" target="working">
        <assign location="agent" expr="_event.data.agent"/>
      </transition>
    </state>
    <state id="working">
      <transition event="agent.replied" target="waiting_on_customer">
        <assign location="replies" expr="replies + 1"/>
      </transition>
    </state>
    <state id="waiting_on_customer">
      <onentry><send id="nudge" event="customer.nudge" delay="7200s"/></onentry>
      <transition event="customer.replied" target="working">
        <cancel sendid="nudge"/>
      </transition>
      <transition event="customer.nudge">
        <log label="nudge" expr="'reminding ' + customer"/>
      </transition>
    </state>
  </state>
  <state id="resolved">
    <onentry><send id="autoclose" event="ticket.autoclose" delay="86400s"/></onentry>
    <transition event="customer.replied" target="open"/>
    <transition event="ticket.autoclose" target="closed"/>
  </state>
  <final id="closed"/>
</scxml>

sources.name: sla.scxml
sources.text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="sla" initial="running">
  <datamodel><data id="minutes" expr="240"/></datamodel>
  <state id="running">
    <onentry><send id="deadline" event="deadline" delayexpr="(minutes * 60) + 's'"/></onentry>
    <transition event="deadline" target="breached"/>
  </state>
  <state id="breached">
    <onentry><send target="#_parent" event="sla.breached"/></onentry>
  </state>
</scxml>
